_comment: The judge prompt is frozen. held_out_guard() refuses held-out scoring unless the prompt, rubric and rubric axes still hash to these values. Freezing is a recorded act: an agreement number computed on the set the judge was tuned against measures nothing (SPEC/03).
frozen_after: the version-2 dev pass at k_judge=3 (milestones/M03/judge/dev-guardrail-2/)
tuning: None. The prompt was written once, before the dev pass, and has not been edited since. The dev pass yielded four judged case-instances and two borderline disagreements - too little signal to tune against, and tuning toward labels drafted by this same model family is the circularity the 0% correction rate already flagged. Frozen untuned, and that is recorded rather than claimed as rigour.
